maddeler.e:
أزدرع (form VIII)
# أَزْدَرِعُ (ʔazdariʕu) /ʔaz.da.ri.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# أُزْدَرَعُ (ʔuzdaraʕu) /ʔuz.da.ra.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# أَزْدَرِعَ (ʔazdariʕa) /ʔaz.da.ri.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# أُزْدَرَعَ (ʔuzdaraʕa) /ʔuz.da.ra
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
